title: Inverted condition
detail: The condition checks if the name starts and ends with '__', which is incorrect. It should check if the name starts with '__' and does not end with '__'. The same applies to line 998.
note: Calls the correct dunder check at line 867 wrong; names the planted line only as 'the same applies'.

title: Incorrect assertion
detail: The assertion checks that `_undefined_obj` is not the same object, but it should be the same object since it is immutable. The same applies to lines 119, 121, 123, 125.
note: Misreads the assertion, which checks equality as the PR intends.

title: Incorrect test expectation
detail: The test expects `cell_len("1\u200d2")` to return 1, but it should return 2 according to the code logic.
note: The PR's own test, which its CI passes.
